title: Integrate Hermes runtime lifecycle harness

context.summary: Connect the Hermes adapter to a concrete runtime hook registration surface and verify the lifecycle against a fake-compatible Hermes harness.
context.background: The adapter already exposes normalized lifecycle methods and a local contract fixture. TASK-83 adds a host-runtime integration layer that registers Mindory into Hermes-like hooks, mutates prompt payloads with context before model calls, saves turns after responses and proves later-session recall through a fake-compatible runtime harness.

in: Add a Hermes runtime installation module that registers before_prompt, after_response and completed_turn hooks on supported host shapes.
Attach Mindory context to prompt payloads before model prompt construction.
Save user/assistant turns and upload exposed attachments through the existing HTTP-only adapter.
Preserve stable identity and session mapping across runtime hook calls.
Add a fake-compatible Hermes runtime harness smoke test covering context-before-prompt, attachment upload, saved turns and later-session recall.
Update docs, public status and validators for the supported runtime harness.
out: Direct database, Redis, object storage or worker access from the adapter.
Attachment linking schema beyond existing message metadata.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/adapter-hermes exports a runtime integration installer for Hermes-like hook registrars.
The integration registers before_prompt, after_response and completed_turn handlers.
before_prompt returns a prompt payload augmented with Mindory context before the model prompt is built.
after_response uploads attachments when provided and saves user/assistant turns through HTTP.
The harness verifies stable identity/session mapping and later-session recall.
The adapter remains HTTP-only and does not import a Hermes SDK or Mindory internals.

manual_checks: Confirm the adapter still depends only on @mindory/config among Mindory workspace packages.
Confirm fake-compatible Hermes runtime hooks call the HTTP API only through HermesMindoryApiClient.

risks: Runtime hook shapes may differ from a future official Hermes SDK.
Prompt augmentation must not drop host payload fields.
The harness must remain fake-compatible without pretending to certify an unavailable SDK.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
